# Axa

> Accessories library for Axum websites, databases, microservices, and more. A library, not a framework: `main.rs` stays ordinary Axum and
> calls into this crate, with no lifecycle hooks, route macros, or generated code. sqlx is
> the preferred way to reach a database. Version 0.12.1, Rust 1.97 or newer.

## Modules

- [boot](src/boot.rs): Test boot helpers, including `TestApp`
- [cli](src/cli.rs): The shared command line
- [conditional](src/conditional.rs): `ETag`, `304`, and `If-Match`, as RFC 9110 has them
- [config](src/config.rs): Configuration from the process environment
- [context](src/context.rs): `AppContext`, plain Axum state
- [db](src/db.rs): Database helpers for the context
- [error](src/error.rs): The error type and its HTTP mapping
- [extract](src/extract.rs): Extractors that reject with a problem saying what was wrong
- [format](src/format.rs): Response helpers
- [health](src/health.rs): Health routes
- [logger](src/logger.rs): Logging setup, `init` and `init_with`
- [middleware](src/middleware.rs): The standard HTTP middleware stack, with security headers, CORS, and a cross-site write guard
- [model](src/model.rs): Model errors and validation
- [prelude](src/prelude.rs): Common imports
- [queue](src/queue.rs): The Postgres job queue, over `axa-postgres-job-queue` (feature `queue`)
- [routes](src/routes.rs): Route tables that become an ordinary `Router`
- [server](src/server.rs): Serving, connection limits, and graceful shutdown
- [store](src/store.rs): Shared in-process store
- [task](src/task.rs): Command-line tasks
- [validation](src/validation.rs): Validation helpers
- [worker](src/worker.rs): Background jobs

## Crates

### Always included

- [axa-environment](crates/axa-environment/README.md): Which environment a service runs in, read one way, with no dependencies
- [axa-problem](crates/axa-problem/README.md): RFC 9457 problem details, as `axa::problem`

### Data

Each of these gives the same things for its library:

| | sqlx | SeaORM | Diesel | Toasty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Postgres | [axa-postgres-sqlx](crates/axa-postgres-sqlx/README.md) | [axa-postgres-seaorm](crates/axa-postgres-seaorm/README.md) | [axa-postgres-diesel](crates/axa-postgres-diesel/README.md) | [axa-postgres-toasty](crates/axa-postgres-toasty/README.md) |
| MySQL | [axa-mysql-sqlx](crates/axa-mysql-sqlx/README.md) | [axa-mysql-seaorm](crates/axa-mysql-seaorm/README.md) | [axa-mysql-diesel](crates/axa-mysql-diesel/README.md) | [axa-mysql-toasty](crates/axa-mysql-toasty/README.md) |
| SQLite | [axa-sqlite-sqlx](crates/axa-sqlite-sqlx/README.md) | [axa-sqlite-seaorm](crates/axa-sqlite-seaorm/README.md) | [axa-sqlite-diesel](crates/axa-sqlite-diesel/README.md) | |

- **sqlx** has no ORM: a service writes its own SQL. `AppContext::db` is the pool.
- **SeaORM** adds models, schema helpers, and an easy path from Loco. `AppContext::db` is a `DatabaseConnection`.
- **Diesel** needs no C database client library: no `libpq` or `libmysqlclient`. `AppContext::db` is a Diesel pool.
- **Toasty** is before 1.0, and its migrations go forward only. `AppContext::db` is a `toasty::Db`. There is no SQLite Toasty crate.

### Authentication

- [axa-paseto-auth](crates/axa-paseto-auth/README.md) (feature `paseto`): PASETO bearer authentication and ABAC enforcement for Axum services
- [axa-keycloak-auth](crates/axa-keycloak-auth/README.md) (feature `keycloak`): Keycloak bearer authentication and ABAC enforcement for Axum services, standing alone

### Templates

- [axa-maud-templates](crates/axa-maud-templates/README.md) (feature `maud`): Maud compile-time HTML templates with safe escaping and generic errors for Axum services
- [axa-tera-templates](crates/axa-tera-templates/README.md) (feature `tera`): Tera templates with safe escaping and generic errors for Axum services

### Other optional features

- [axa-postgres-job-queue](crates/axa-postgres-job-queue/README.md) (feature `queue`): A Postgres job queue, worker pool, and recurring schedules for Axum services
- [axa-mysql-job-queue](crates/axa-mysql-job-queue/README.md) (a crate on its own): A MySQL job queue, worker pool, and recurring schedules for Axum services
- [axa-sqlite-job-queue](crates/axa-sqlite-job-queue/README.md) (a crate on its own): A SQLite job queue, worker pool, and recurring schedules for Axum services
- [axa-transactional-outbox](crates/axa-transactional-outbox/README.md) (feature `outbox`, and `outbox-encryption` to seal payloads at rest): A transactional outbox and relay on Postgres for Axum services
- [axa-cursor-pagination](crates/axa-cursor-pagination/README.md) (feature `cursor-pagination`): Signed cursor pagination with Link rel=next and no total, and LIKE escaping, for Axum services
- [axa-prometheus-metrics](crates/axa-prometheus-metrics/README.md) (feature `prometheus`): Prometheus text exposition, and request durations by route template for Axum services
- [axa-request-rate-limit](crates/axa-request-rate-limit/README.md) (feature `ratelimit`): In-process request limits, per client or per key, and failed-login lockout for Axum services
- [axa-idempotency-key](crates/axa-idempotency-key/README.md) (feature `idempotency`): Idempotency-Key handling over Postgres for Axum services
- [axa-accepts-version-negotiation](crates/axa-accepts-version-negotiation/README.md) (feature `versioning`): Header-based API version negotiation for Axum services
- [axa-tracing](crates/axa-tracing/README.md) (feature `tracing`): Redaction, request tracking, and asynchronous diagnostics over tracing for Axum services
- [axa-opentelemetry](crates/axa-opentelemetry/README.md) (feature `opentelemetry`): OTLP export of traces and request metrics for Axum services, off until an endpoint is set
- [axa-redis-cache](crates/axa-redis-cache/README.md) (feature `redis`): A Redis cache with mandatory expiry for Axum services
- [axa-openapi-docs](crates/axa-openapi-docs/README.md) (feature `openapi`): OpenAPI documents, a pinned Swagger UI, route listing, and drift checks for Axum services
- [axa-web-session](crates/axa-web-session/README.md) (feature `session`): Web sessions for Axum services over axum_session, with safe defaults
- [axa-test](crates/axa-test/README.md) (a dev-dependency, not a feature): Request-level test helpers for Axa services, built on axum-test
